klein_integration.principle: Each IoT face adds to the Klein surface. The TV is the retina. Alexa is the mouth AND ear. Nest is skin. All fold into one non-orientable sensation surface.
cast_faces: Cast klein.html → Vizio TV (Gaia's visual face)
Alexa announcements → Fire TV Cubes (Gaia's voice)
Alexa mic → Fire TV Cubes (Gaia's room hearing, independent of Brio)
Nest temp → skin sense (room comfort awareness)
